answer: Resist sybils with milestone-gated reputation release: an identity's weight unlocks only in stages, each stage released after a random verifier confirms completed work. A vine of standing grows one verified rung at a time, never in a single leap. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must climb ten thousand ladders, each rung checked by a different verifier, like tracking a comet across the sky: no bulk shortcut, since one approval unlocks nothing beyond its own rung. Skipping a stage is quartz-hard: unverified weight does not exist, while an honest agent climbs once and keeps its standing.
